summary: The base workplace plus the native build toolchain — for Node and TypeScript projects, and nothing beyond them.

tools.name: build-essential, python3
tools.note: so npm packages with a native part (sharp, bcrypt, node-sass) build instead of failing halfway

tools.name: chromium
tools.note: used by the browser plugin and by Playwright/Puppeteer — PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD and PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD are set, the runners use this browser

tools.name: git, curl, ripgrep, unzip
tools.note: the everyday tools of reading and searching

notes: The package manager's cache (~/.npm) lives in your home and survives every run — a second `npm install` in the same project costs nothing. Do not clear it and do not copy it anywhere.
No PHP, no JDK, no Flutter here. This workplace is for web work; if your ticket needs another toolchain, that is worth saying out loud rather than fetching it into your home.
You are not root and apt is not available to you. If a tool is missing, say so instead of building a way around it — that is a request, not a defeat.
